links.outcome: Precision/recall of symptom extraction across four prompt strategies (constraints, overinference)
links.effect: Instruction-only prompting gave high recall but poor precision; adding structure and constraints improved performance. On test set, Llama 3.3-70B precision 0.63 vs gpt-oss-120B 0.89 for S&S extraction.
links.quote: Instruction-only prompting demonstrated high recall but poor precision.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering strategies (ICD-10-CM definition-based, assumption-free prompts, multimodule framework with postprocessing) to improve LLM extraction accuracy
Locally deployed open-weight LLMs for on-premises processing to enhance data safety

screen.reason: The study empirically compares four prompting strategies and postprocessing guardrails (e.g., assumption-free prompts, ICD definitions, multimodule postprocessing) to mitigate hallucinations/overinference when extracting symptoms from clinical notes.

primary.practice: prompt engineering constraints and multimodule postprocessing
